precepts.text: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth. Did we not read about those twelve Caesars? They were all Edomites, from that time to this time. The eagle represents Esau; the end comes through Esau.
precepts.point: We close with this. A roaring lion chased out of the wood, that is Christ, sent out a man's voice, the prophets, unto the eagle: Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them? That fourth beast was the eagle. The Lord made them reign in his world, and the end of times shall come through this eagle.

note.label: America: The New Roman Empire

precepts.why:
The roaring lion chased out of the wood is Christ, and he sent out a man’s voice, the prophets, unto the eagle: “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” That fourth beast is the eagle. The Lord made them reign in his world, and the end of times shall come through this eagle.

Ezra already said who that is: “For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” The end comes through Esau. Did we not read about those twelve Caesars? They were all Edomites, from that time to this time. The eagle represents Esau.

“The fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness.” Put the bases up on the map: America is everywhere, over the whole compass of the earth. Rome did not have that, but America does. It rules “with much wicked oppression”, not with righteousness. Captain Ibrahim Traore said it: democracy kills. They put democracy in Libya, and look at Libya today, destroyed; Somalia, destroyed. “And so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit”: everything that comes out of that man’s mouth in the White House is a lie.

So when Esau’s eagle is finished, the world that follows belongs to Jacob. “Appear no more, thou eagle”, that all the earth may be refreshed and delivered from his violence: that is you and me.

precepts.text: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable multitude.
precepts.point: For the earth hast thou not judged with truth: America set herself up as the police of the earth, but she has not judged the earth with truth. For thou hast afflicted the meek, that is Judah; thou hast hurt the peaceable, that is the northern kingdom. I am going to prove that.

note.label: America: The New Roman Empire

precepts.why:
The lion charges the eagle: “For the earth hast thou not judged with truth.” America set herself up as the police of the earth, but she has not judged the earth with truth. “For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable.” The meek is Judah, and the peaceable is the northern kingdom, and Ezra proves it.

“Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable Multitude.” The man from the mountain is Christ, and when he comes he calls unto him another peaceable multitude. That peaceable multitude is Israel, the tribes he gathers. So when the lion tells the eagle “thou hast hurt the peaceable”, he is speaking of the same people he calls to himself.

“Thou hast loved liars”: if you lie you can be their friend, a senator, a mayor. They sat in Congress and lied, especially about the Epstein files, all of them lying. And they “destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.” The northern kingdom here did them no harm, and they said destroy them, and enslaved them.

That is why “thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest.” What America did to the peaceable and the meek of the earth has come up before the Most High, and he has considered it.

precepts.text: And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him: those are the ten tribes. So thou hast hurt the peaceable is the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, the northern kingdom.
precepts.point: For the earth hast thou not judged with truth: America set herself up as the police of the earth, but she has not judged the earth with truth. For thou hast afflicted the meek, that is Judah; thou hast hurt the peaceable, that is the northern kingdom. I am going to prove that.

note.label: America: The New Roman Empire

precepts.why:
The angel explains the vision to Ezra: “And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him”, those are the ten tribes. So when the lion says to the eagle, “thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable”, it is the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, the northern kingdom. The eagle afflicted both.

The northern kingdom here did them no harm, and they cast down their walls, destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and enslaved them. That wrongful dealing and that pride has come up unto the Highest.

“The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.” The proud times are the time of their technology. “And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws”, the militaries, “nor all thy vain body”, the citizens. This is the end of the eagle.

Then the peaceable multitude comes home: “That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from thy violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.” That is you and me right there. Twelve tribes.

precepts.why:
The eagle is the white man, Esau, Edom, and in particular America in his last days: it starts with Rome and America ends it. The eagle said, “let the heads be preserved for the last”, and one of those three heads is America. Then Ezra saw “the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.” The voice of the eagle does not come from the heads. It comes from the body, what they call the deep state.

That is what President Assad of Syria was saying: the president is not the guy, it is the deep state behind him. Y’all look at Trump like he is the guy. He is a figurehead, a manager. Barack Hussein Obama secretly bombed seven countries, and Trump eight. The people behind the administration are the ones calling the shots, never the man sitting in the seat.

Ephesians says it: “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” You think you are fighting against Trump? You are not fighting against Trump.

Look at the pyramid. The Luciferian eye at the top, the same eye on the dollar bill. The Crown Council of 13, the world’s richest and most powerful families, and Trump cannot go beyond what they say. Beneath them the sub families; then the think tanks, the Trilateral Commission, the Council on Foreign Relations, the United Nations, the Bilderberg Group, the Club of Rome; then world financial control, the IMF, the World Bank, the central banks, the Bank of International Settlements. Under that, religions, governments, education and the media all add to the control. At the bottom are the sheep, debt slaves. That is us.

They work with spirits; they work with demons. The whole system is set up in a demonic way. That is why the black man or black woman who says he is going into the government to change things has never succeeded. You want to destroy all that above you? Only God can do that.

precepts.point: Habakkuk 3:16, the prophet's belly trembled because he was put in it, and when he cometh up unto the people he will invade them with his troops. Isaiah 31:4, like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, the Lion of the tribe of Judah of Revelation 5:5, so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion; as birds flying, Christ and the angels, he will defend Jerusalem, and passing over he will preserve it. Jeremiah 4:7, the lion is come up from his thicket, the destroyer of the Gentiles, Nebuchadnezzar contextually and Christ prophetically. 2 Esdras 11:37, a roaring lion chased out of the wood sends a man's voice unto the eagle, America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The lion is Christ, roaring on his prey and coming up from his thicket as the destroyer of the Gentiles. Ezra saw the same lion: “And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle”.

This eagle is America. The roaring lion sending his voice unto the eagle is Christ roaring against America, bringing destruction.

So when the destruction that wasteth at noonday comes on America, the Lord is the mighty protection of them that love him, a defence from heat and a cover from the sun at noon, while he roars against the eagle and fights for mount Zion.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
The eagle is told, “thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.” The fourth beast was Rome, and America is its extension, ruling with much wicked oppression. America just bombed a school and killed 165 schoolgirls. Wicked as hell. Habakkuk shows what comes back on such a nation.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee”. America has spoiled many nations, and now we see it is America and Israel, Trump and Netanyahu, doing it together. What is the reason? “because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.”

So the remnant of the people, the nations America has spoiled, shall spoil it. That is what we are watching as Iran answers with missiles the Iron Dome cannot stop, a single missile that turns into eighty. The eagle that cast down the walls of such as did it no harm will have its own walls cast down, because of men's blood.

precepts.why:
Why are these nations mad? Because America has been a tyrant. Jeremiah gives the reason: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.”

The nations have drunk of her wine, meaning her lies and her philosophies. Therefore the nations are mad: they are angry. Of the eagle it is said, “so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit”, and “thou hast loved liars”, the dirty, grimy lawyers who manipulate the law to do America's bidding. Not every lawyer is wicked, and some of our brothers are lawyers with good intent, but those who twist the law for her are the liars she loves.

Babylon is a golden cup in the Lord's hand. The Lord made her to reign in his world, that the end of their times might come through them, and the nations drunk on her wine are now turning against her. Daniel gives that wine another name.

precepts.text: Through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand, and he shall magnify himself in his heart. The policy is the wine of Jeremiah 51:7.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the nations have drunk of Babylon's wine and are mad. Daniel uses another word instead of wine: “And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart”.

Through his policy: that is the wine. His policy, his lies and philosophies, are what he gives the nations to drink, and by it he causes craft, deceit, to prosper in his hand. That is the fourth beast of whom Ezra says, “so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit”, that did not judge the earth with truth.

And he magnifies himself in his heart. America in its arrogance kills leaders, bombs in the middle of negotiations, and thinks no one can touch it. But the nations drunk on its policy are mad at it, and oppression unites them.

In the middle of all this war, Isaiah sees the prophets still going out: “Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand”. The banner is the Bible. “Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men”. Since we know what the Lord is going to do, we must persuade our people to change their lives while there is time.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart

precepts.why:
The roaring lion, Christ, comes out of the wood and speaks to the eagle, to America: “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” Who is going to be ruling in the last kingdom? Ezra already said it: “For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.”

That lets you know that Esau is not done away. He is not gone off the face of the earth. How could he be, when he is the ruler of the last kingdom? Esau is still on the earth. He is that white man you are trying to protect and hide. And the ones who say Esau is the Arabs: be quiet, and listen to Bishop Nathanyel, the other Bishops and the deacons. They will teach you something.

The end is going to come through Esau. He is the fourth beast that “had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression”, from Iran to America. “For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable”: that is us. He has cast down the walls of such as did him no harm: blacks and Hispanics chased down by ICE, who only came for a low-level job and minded their own business, called rapists and murderers.

“Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty.” However much they present themselves as a Christian country and think God is proud of them, God has not forgotten Babylon the Great. Esau is the end of this world, and Jacob is the beginning of the one that follows.

note.label: Judgement - the Testimony of the Two Witnesses

precepts.why:
Ezra sees “a roaring lion chased out of the wood”, and he “sent out a man's voice unto the eagle”. The eagle is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of it. The roaring lion is Christ, but first it is us, the prophets: a man's voice speaking to the eagle. That is the witnesses on the earth today condemning the so-called white man, Edom, for all the evil he has done through the centuries. God has not forgotten slavery, Jim Crow, the destruction of Jerusalem by Rome. He does not forget anything.

How will we overcome that beast? “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.” We overcome the beast, Edom, by the blood of Christ, and by the word of our testimony.

What is our testimony? The words of the prophets. We are teaching the laws and the words of the prophets, revealing that he has ruled with deceit, set himself up as the Jews and the people of God, and dwelt on this earth “with much wicked oppression”. In a court of law the witnesses must bring their testimony before judgment comes, and the whole earth is our courtroom. When we speak, the Lord is speaking through us, the spirit of his mouth.

And by the blood of the Lamb, meaning Christ having mercy on us. If you make a mistake, fix it. If you are struggling with things inside, fix it. If you fall, get back up; Christ will have mercy on you. But you also have to have his testimony. That is how we overcome this wicked society, and then the eagle, its horrible wings, wicked feathers, malicious heads and hurtful claws, will appear no more.

So when you read about the fourth part and ask, is it just Africa? It said they had power over the world. “and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression;” With much wicked oppression. “and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.”
